response.text:
Both tests pass now.

The failing test expects `parseRange("7")` to return `{ from: 7, to: 7 }`, but the code did `text.split("-")` which for a single number yields `["7"]`, so `to` was `undefined` → `Number(undefined)` = `NaN`.

Fix in `parse-range.mjs`: default `to` to `from` when the input has no dash:

```js
const[from, to = from] = text.split("-");
```
